title: Critic-rule test does not prove relay delivered the rule
what: The case must make the rule reachable only through relay's delivery.
why: The paid case for a project rule reaching the reviewer passed, but in 2 of 3 runs the agent read the rule file itself, so a pass does not show relay delivered the rule.
failing_case: In 2 of 3 runs of the paid critic-rule case the agent opened the rule file itself and still passed.
pass_cases: The rule file is not readable by the agent, and the case passes only when relay's delivery carries the rule.
